name: Inquestor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
When the religious protocols of an inquisition fail to bring results, a secular inquest can be made to fill in the gaps of the inquiry. Inquestors employ the mundane techniques of investigators to get the answers they need. Armed with faith and the facts, there is no truth they cannot uncover.

Inspiration (Ex)

Starting at 3rd level, and inquestor gains an inspiration pool as the investigator class feature, with the following changes:

The inspiration pool is equal to 1/2 the inquisitor’s level + her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).
Uses of inspiration can only be expended to augment inquisitor class skill checks and using investigator talents, not for ability checks, attack rolls, Reflex saving throws, or skill checks for non-class skills.

This replaces solo tactics.

Investigator Talents

At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, an inquestor gains an investigator talent. Except where otherwise noted, each investigator talent can only be selected once. The inquestor qualifies for the Extra Inspiration feat, treating her inquisitor level as her investigator level.

This replaces the teamwork feats gained at these levels.
